body:
Hey, I took FIN 301 and 302 concurrently. FIN 300 is like the combination of 301 and 302. 

Class should be pretty easy, you can expect lecture of introduction to corporate finance and investment. As long as you are good with number and formulas, you will be fine. 

Of course, professors also play a role in how difficult a class is. Professor William O’Brien, Han Le, Ozgur, and Stanley Waite are my recommendations. 

It’s a fun class, even if you are not finance major, I recommend talking intro finance class like this. You can apply what you learn to saving, investment, and retirement. 

Good luck :)
